slides.title: Layers of Clean Architecture
slides.prompt: Clean Architecture organizes software into concentric layers: Entities (Core Business Rules), Use Cases (Application Business Rules), Controllers/Presenters (Interface Adapters), and Frameworks/DB (External Drivers). The dependency rule enforces that inner layers know nothing of outer layers.

slides.title: Clean Architecture Dependency Direction
slides.prompt: Fill in the direction dependencies must point in Clean Architecture.
slides.codeSnippet:
# Source code dependencies must point ___ towards business logic
# Outer -> Inner

slides.title: Domain Layer Independence
slides.prompt: Which component should NEVER be imported into the core Domain Entity layer?
options: Database ORMs, Web Frameworks, and external API libraries
Standard Python primitive types (int, str, dict)
slides.correctAnswer: Database ORMs, Web Frameworks, and external API libraries

slides.title: Repository Pattern Abstraction
slides.prompt: Fill in the pattern name that isolates domain entities from data persistence logic.

slides.title: Use Case Layer Responsibility
slides.prompt: What is the primary role of the Use Case layer in Clean Architecture?
options: To orchestrate data flow to and from domain entities to fulfill application requirements
To render HTML UI templates directly for client browsers
To define database table schemas and SQL migrations
To handle raw HTTP network socket connections
slides.correctAnswer: To orchestrate data flow to and from domain entities to fulfill application requirements

slides.title: Ports and Adapters Alternative Name
slides.prompt: Fill in the architectural synonym commonly used for Ports and Adapters Architecture.
slides.codeSnippet: Ports and Adapters is also known as ___ Architecture.

slides.title: Testability in Clean Architecture
slides.prompt: Why does Clean Architecture significantly improve unit testing capabilities?
options: Core business logic can be tested in isolation using mock repositories without running a real database or server
It forces all unit tests to execute in parallel across GPU threads
It automatically generates test cases based on type annotations
It removes the need for test assertions in Python
slides.correctAnswer: Core business logic can be tested in isolation using mock repositories without running a real database or server
